findings.location: Poem, stanza 1, line 3 ("Dayspring shineth from on high")
findings.source_quote: The Dayspring shineth from on high
findings.suggested_fix: Consider using a more common Afrikaans term for poetic clarity, e.g. "Die dagbreek skyn van hoog in die hemele" or keep "Dagskynding" if you prefer a more archaic/poetic tone.
findings.translation_quote: Die Dagskynding skyn van hoog in die hemele

findings.location: Poem, stanza 1, line 4 ("The grace of God to man is nigh!")
findings.source_quote: The grace of God to man is nigh!
findings.suggested_fix: Improve idiomatic flow: change "Die genade van God na die mens is naby!" to "Die genade van God aan die mens is naby!" or "God se genade is vir die mens naby!"
findings.translation_quote: Die genade van God na die mens is naby!

findings.location: Poem, stanza 3, line 2 ("And worship Him with reverent praise;")
findings.source_quote: And worship Him with reverent praise;
findings.suggested_fix: "Dien Hom met eerbiedige lof" is acceptable but slightly unusual; consider "Aanbid Hom met eerbiedige lof" or "Aanbid Hom met eerbiedige lofprysing" for closer lexical match.
findings.translation_quote: En dien Hom met eerbiedige lof;
